title: Human mitochondrial genome sequenced
summary: A group led by Frederick Sanger published the full 16,569-letter human mitochondrial DNA sequence (the Cambridge Reference Sequence). A corrected version followed in 1999.
why: The reference that maternal-ancestry studies, including 'Mitochondrial Eve', were built on.

notes.problem: Spelling mismatch: summary 'Fred Sanger' vs figures 'Frederick Sanger'.
